Want to have yummy Nachos? That will require yummy Cheese Sauce!
This recipe is based on one from a restaurant named Rusty Taco, and it is AWESOME!!!
Velveeta Cheese ½ Lb.1 Cup
OnionFresh ¼
Pickled JalapeñosCanned 2½ Tablespoons
Diced TomatoesCanned 1½ Tablespoons
Cumin¼ teaspoon Pepper⅛ teaspoon
MilkWhole ½ Cupor ⅓
Jalapeno JuiceFrom Pickled Jalapeños Can 1-3 teaspoons
Cut the Velveeta Cheese into 4 chunks. Dice the Onion into ≈¼&inch; chunks.
Throw all ingredients into a double boiler. Stir with a whisk for about 15 minutes, until the sauce is thick but pourable and all ingredients are visible.
A double boiler is a tool for melting things without overcooking or burning them. If you don't have a double boiler, you can work-around it by:
Get a skillet that is ≈3&inch;-4&inch; deep. (Or a shallow pot with a large diameter)
Get a small pot or pan with a handle that will hold the ingredients, and will fit into the skillet without touching the sides.
Fill the skillet with water, to the point that the small pot can be placed inside, not touching the bottom, without overflowing out of the skillet or into the pot.
Bring the water to a boil.
Put ingredients in the small pot and carefully set it in the skillet, not touching the bottom or sides, and cook for the appropriate amount of time.
The Jalapeños and Tomatoes come from a can, but you won't use the entire can of either, so you might want to consider also doing another recipe to use them up.
